test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows.

Counting to be done from left to right only.

(NOTE: All numbers are single digit numbers only.)

(Left) 3 % 2 % 2 £ £ & © £ 1 1 8 5 $ 9 9 5 2 & 5 6 (Right)

How many such numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 3 % 2 % 2 £ £ & © £ 1 1 8 5 $ 9 9 5 2 & 5 6 (Right)

According to the question,

Required condition: Symbol - Number - Symbol

(Left) 3 __**% 2 % 2 £**__ £ & © £ 1 1 8 5 $ 9 9 5 2 & 5 6 (Right)

Thus, there are two such numbers which are immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer
